name: file-tree
description: A folder structure as a tree you can fold, with file counts per folder. Pass what `tree` printed (tree -F marks folders best), or `paths` from find, git ls-files or rg --files. Use when showing a project's layout or where files live.

find.description: A name or path to find: opens the tree down to it and marks it. Use it to show where something lives.

title.description: Card title, e.g. what was run for.

command.description: The command, shown under the title.
